\begin{multicols}{2}
\begin{enumerate}
\item [\textbf{2)}]Evaluate $x^{2}-5(x-y)$ for $x=6$ and $y=2$\vspace{0cm}
\begin{eqnarray*}
[x]^{2}-5([x]-[y]) & = & [6]^{2}-5([6]-[2])\\
 & = & 36-5(6-2)\\
 & = & 36-5(4)\\
 & = & 36-20\\
 & = & \mathbf{16}
\end{eqnarray*}
\item [\textbf{24)}]Evaluate $(-3)^{3}(-2)^{2}$\vspace{0cm}
\begin{eqnarray*}
(-3)^{3}(-2)^{2} & = & (-3)(-3)(-3)(-2)(-2)\\
 & = & -27\cdot4\\
 & = & \mathbf{-108}
\end{eqnarray*}
\item [\textbf{30)}]Evaluate $(2x^{3})^{-4}$\vspace{0cm}
\begin{eqnarray*}
(2x^{3})^{-4} & = & 2^{-4}x^{3\cdot(-4)}\\
 & = & \frac{1}{2^{4}}x^{-12}\\
 & = & \frac{1}{2^{4}x^{12}}\\
 & = & \mathbf{\frac{1}{16x^{12}}}
\end{eqnarray*}
\item [\textbf{32)}]Evaluate$3.74\times10^{4}$\vspace{0cm}
\begin{eqnarray*}
 & = & 37.4\times10^{3}\\
 & = & 374\times10^{2}\\
 & = & 3,740\times10^{1}\\
 & = & \mathbf{37,400}
\end{eqnarray*}
\item [\textbf{32)}]Simplify $\frac{\sqrt{96x^{3}}}{\sqrt{2x}}$\vspace{0cm}
\begin{eqnarray*}
 & = & \sqrt{\frac{96x^{3}}{2x}}\\
 & = & \sqrt{48x^{2}}\\
 & = & x\sqrt{2^{4}\cdot3}\\
 & = & 2^{2}x\sqrt{3}\\
 & = & 4x\sqrt{3}
\end{eqnarray*}
\end{enumerate}
%%\vfill
\columnbreak
\begin{enumerate}
\item [\textbf{90)}]Factor $x^{2}-11x+28$\\
$(-7)(-4)=28$ and $-7x+-4x=-11x$\\
so $x^{2}-11x+28=(x-7)(x-4)$
\item [\textbf{98)}]Factor $x^{4}-16$\\
The difference of squares: $a^{2}-b^{2}=(a+b)(a-b)$
\begin{eqnarray*}
x^{4}-16 & = & (x^{2}-4)(x^{2}+4)\\
 & = & \mathbf{(x-2)(x+2)(x^{2}+4})
\end{eqnarray*}
\item [\textbf{110)}]Simplify $\frac{x^{2}+3x-18}{x^{2}-36}$ 
\begin{eqnarray*}
= & \frac{x^{2}+3x-18}{(x-6)(x+6)} & \mbox{Diff. of Squares}\\
= & \frac{(x+6)(x-3)}{(x-6)(x+6)}\\
= & \mathbf{\frac{x-3}{x-6}} & \mathbf{x\neq\pm6}
\end{eqnarray*}
\item [\textbf{120)}]Simplify $\frac{3+\frac{12}{x}}{1-\frac{16}{x^{2}}}$
\begin{eqnarray*}
 & = & \frac{\frac{3x}{x}+\frac{12}{x}}{\frac{x^{2}}{x^{2}}-\frac{16}{x^{2}}}\\
 & = & \frac{\frac{3x+12}{x}}{\frac{x^{2}-16}{x^{2}}}\\
 & = & \left(\frac{3x+12}{x}\right)\frac{x^{2}}{x^{2}-16}\\
 & = & \frac{x(3x+12)}{x^{2}-16}\\
 & = & \frac{3x(x+4)}{(x-4)(x+4)}\\
 & = & \frac{\mathbf{3x}}{\mathbf{x-4}}\mbox{ }\mathbf{x\neq0,\pm4}
\end{eqnarray*}
\end{enumerate}
\end{multicols}
